title: Zesty Spicy Fluffy Uruguayan Kabanos Sausages Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional Uruguayan empanadas featuring spicy kabanos sausages and a tangy pickle relish. Perfect for a cozy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Combine wheat flour and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add warm water, stirring with a fork until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Cut out a circle of dough slightly larger than the kabanos sausage.
Place a kabanos sausage in the center of the dough circle.
Add a spoonful of pickle relish and a sprinkle of shredded cheddar cheese.
Brush edges of dough with olive oil and fold in half to form a half-moon shape.
Press edges together to seal empanada.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat with remaining dough and filling ingredients.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
